activeContentScan.supersededClaim: An earlier run of this audit reported 456/456 artifacts clean. That number counted the 136 contact sheets as clean when their verdict was in fact unavailable. The finalized-artifact half of the claim stands; the contact-sheet half did not.
activeContentScan.rootCause: buildContactSheet in the D0 factory never scans its output, and scanBytesForActiveContent's inspectable:false is not enforced by callers, so an unverifiable result reads as a clean one. Independent review shard 0 re-serialized the sheets without object streams and found real /AA and /JS widget objects in 20 of the 44 sheets it inspected, copied in by embedPdf from the blank source.
